source.title: Call for Applicants - WMT Members (January 2024)
source.content:
The WCA Marketing Team is seeking new members! 

**What does the WCA Marketing Team Do?**

The WMT is responsible for branding and marketing of the WCA through initiatives, managing WCA relationships with media and external partners, managing and coordinating the WCA Merchandise and increasing awareness of speedcubing around the world through collaborations and advertising.

**Why join the WMT?**

Have you ever wondered, “‘Wow, cubing is so much fun, I wish more people knew about it”? Have you found excitement by getting friends to go to a WCA competition? Have you ever wanted competitions to have higher stakes, bigger venues, prizes, and audiences? The WCA Marketing Team has too, and we want you to help us get there! With the immense growth of the WCA, this is the perfect opportunity to make your ideas of growing cubing turn into reality! 

Here are some of the projects WMT is currently working on:

* Media Relationships:
 * WMT manages relationships with traditional media and speedcubing media to promote initiatives, information about speedcubing, and sparking collaborations to grow our audience 
* Merchandising:
 * WMT owns the [WCA Merchandising](https://wca.link/shop) ecosystem, including designing, advertising and coordinating WCA merchandise across the world 
* Marketing Initiatives:
 * WMT works on new marketing initiatives that grow and promote our organization, such as the [WCA Newcomer Month](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/world-cube-association-hosts-newcomer-month-inviting-everyone-to-join-the-thrilling-world-of-competitive-speedcubing)

The application is open to everyone. Potential applicants do not have to hold a current position to be considered. 
<!-- break -->
**Minimum Requirements for Applicants**

* Interest in marketing the WCA and our brand
* Proficiency in English
* Able to commit at least 4 hours per week including attending monthly meetings
* Creative mind and good communication skills

**Specific Skills we are looking for (any of these is a huge plus):**

* Experience in writing Press Releases and working with traditional press outlets
* Experience with design tools like Adobe & Canva
* Experience with Shopify
* Experience in merchandising, email marketing or digital advertising
* Based in Europe/Africa/Oceania/South America (WMT lacks members from these regions)

Applicants should submit a PDF application including a brief personal introduction, their involvement with the WCA, their motivation for applying to the WMT, and any relevant experience or skills.

**Applications should be sent to [sgrover@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:sgrover@worldcubeassociation.org) from now until February 4th, 2024, 23:59 UTC to be considered.**

translation.title: WCA 市场营销组成员招募（2024 年 1 月）
translation.content:
WCA 市场营销组正在招募新成员！

**WCA 市场营销组的工作是什么？**

WMT 通过各类项目开展 WCA 的品牌建设和市场推广，维护 WCA 与媒体及外部合作伙伴的关系，管理和协调 WCA 周边商品，并通过合作与广告，让世界各地更多人了解速拧。

**为什么加入 WMT？**

你是否也想过：“魔方这么好玩，真希望更多人知道！”你是否因为带朋友参加 WCA 比赛而感到兴奋？你是否希望比赛更有分量，有更大的场馆、更好的奖品和更多观众？WCA 市场营销组也有同样的想法，我们希望你能加入，一起实现！随着 WCA 迅速发展，现在正是把推广魔方的想法付诸实践的好机会。

WMT 目前的部分工作包括：

* 媒体关系：
  * WMT 与传统媒体及速拧媒体保持联系，宣传各类项目、传播速拧知识，并寻求合作，让更多人关注魔方。
* 周边商品：
  * WMT 负责 [WCA 周边商品](https://wca.link/shop)的整体运作，包括设计、宣传及全球销售协调。
* 推广项目：
  * WMT 策划新的推广项目，帮助组织发展、扩大影响，例如 [WCA 新人月](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/world-cube-association-hosts-newcomer-month-inviting-everyone-to-join-the-thrilling-world-of-competitive-speedcubing)。

所有人均可申请，无须已在 WCA 任职。

<!-- break -->

**申请人的最低要求：**

* 有兴趣推广 WCA 及其品牌。
* 熟练使用英语。
* 每周至少能投入 4 小时，包括参加月度会议。
* 有创意，善于沟通。

**我们特别欢迎以下技能或条件（具备任何一项都会很有帮助）：**

* 有撰写新闻稿及与传统媒体合作的经验。
* 有 Adobe、Canva 等设计工具的使用经验。
* 有 Shopify 使用经验。
* 有商品销售、电子邮件营销或数字广告经验。
* 居住在欧洲、非洲、大洋洲或南美洲（WMT 目前缺少这些地区的成员）。

请提交 PDF 格式的申请，包含简短的自我介绍、参与 WCA 的经历、申请加入 WMT 的原因，以及相关经验或技能。

**请于即日起至 2024 年 2 月 4 日 23:59 UTC 期间，将申请发送至 [sgrover@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:sgrover@worldcubeassociation.org)。**
